dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I was wondering where you were…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I just needed to be alone…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I like it here… I come here often… It’s like being alone with the world. We freed hundreds of our people, and they’re still coming from all over the city… Those who dream of freedom come to Jericho… Something's changing… You seem preoccupied…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Preoccupied?.. No… No, no, I’m fine…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: All the media are talking about what we did last night… The humans are terrified... They’re afraid of a civil war… Many of our people were burned in response to what happened… The humans hate us… They’ll never give us our freedom.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans aren't gonna give us anything unless we take it… It's up to us to decide how far we’re willing to go to get what's ours.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You haven’t said much about yourself since you’ve been with us… What was your life like before Jericho?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's nothing to say… I was a house android. A slave... just like the others.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Where're you going?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: To talk to the humans.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: This is suicide. We’ll all be killed! Please, Markus… It's not too late to change your mind.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You don't understand… We’re finally gonna show them who we really are. This place will go down in history!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We'll be killed on the spot!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That’s a risk I’m prepared to take if it means freedom for our people…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, please, don’t do this.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: They’ll understand… We’ll make them understand. This is the only way.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: There're androids here who could join us… The more we are, the stronger our message.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Oh man, I’d love one of those.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Why don’t you get it?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: It’s too expensive.  Besides, I don’t want it nagging me while I am running, you know…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Well that’s the whole idea! It motivates you.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Yeah yeah alright, I’ll think about it…  Come on.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey, baby, why don’t we go back to your place?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Why? So you can stare at my fucking android all night?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey! Don’t be like that… I’m telling you, you got the wrong idea!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: So what? You slipped and both hands landed on her tits?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Don’t call it a ‘her’… That’s weird.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Exactly, you fucking pig.

dialogue.speaker: Man 1
dialogue.text: Still can’t believe that fucking video they made…

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: Seeing one of them talk like that, like a person?  Fucking weird.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: You know I bet President Warren is in bed with CyberLife.

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: A company that size? They do whatever they want.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: Maybe that’s why she hasn’t shut them down,  hmm?

dialogue.speaker: Man 1
dialogue.text: Yet. You ever think maybe these androids have a point?  Like, if they’re human enough to want rights, maybe they’re human enough to deserve them?

dialogue.speaker: Man 2
dialogue.text: That is liberal bullshit.

dialogue.speaker: Man 3
dialogue.text: Wash your mouth out, Joe.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Think about it, I mean. Androids are everywhere, and they listen to everything!  Maybe that's the point! CyberLife is recording all that!  I mean... They could be spying on us right now!  Yeah,  and I bet President Warren is in on it too.  Hello?  Nicky?  Are you there?

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Come with us.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Ha finally!  I’ve been on hold for ten minutes! Yes,  I’d like to make a complaint. It’s like I told the last guy!  My android won’t take instructions. Sure, last night, I told it to do some cleaning, it told me “I would prefer not to.” No, no, don’t you put me on hold! Listen to me.  I want this android destroyed, and I want a replacement. Are you listening-? Hello?  Hello?..  God damnit!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You don't have to obey them.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I need to block the street.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey!  Where do you think you’re going?  You get back here! You stay right here, you fucking machine! Shit, what's wrong with you?! You do as I say, you piece of junk!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Leave him alone. He's chosen to be free.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You're free now.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey, where're you goin'?  Get back here right now!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: What are you doing?  I'm talking to you!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.text: Hey! Come back here!  Fuckin' thing won't listen to me!

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Wait, wait! Where are you going?  Jesus, the fucking android's playing up again…

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Greg?  Greg? Come back here immediately!  Greg!  GREG!

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: What the hell are you doin' here?  Hey!  Disperse!  DISPERSE IMMEDIATELY!  THAT'S AN ORDER! Jesus fuckin' Christ… Dispatch, this is patrol 457…  I gotta lot of androids down here…  I dunno… Hundreds?..  Thousands?..  They're marching...  Yeah, they're marching down the street…  Fuck if I know!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We came here to demonstrate peacefully  and tell humans that we are living beings. All we want is to live free.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is an illegal gathering. Disperse immediately or we will open fire.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We're not looking for confrontation. We’ve done no harm, we have no intention of doing any… But know that we are not going anywhere until we have secured our freedom.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: I repeat: this is an illegal gathering.  If you do not disperse immediately, we will shoot!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, they’re gonna kill us… We have to attack! There’s more of us, we can take them!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If we attack, we’ll start a war. We have to show them we’re not violent. We should just stand our ground, even if it means dying here.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: And dying here won’t solve anything. Markus, we need to go, now, before it’s too late.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: This is your last chance!  Disperse immediately or you will all be killed!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to show them we won’t back down. We stay right here.

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: DISPERSE! THIS IS YOUR LAST CHANCE!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We have to make a statement. We have to stay put, no matter what.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Please, Markus. We can't let them slaughter us without fighting back!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Don’t shoot! We're leaving...

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.text: Affirmative.  ON MY ORDERS!

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm… I'm beginning to have thoughts that are… Not part of my program… Maybe… Maybe I've been compromised too…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm… I'm beginning to have thoughts that are… Not part of my program… Maybe… Maybe I've been compromised too…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm… I'm beginning to have thoughts that are… Not part of my program… Maybe… Maybe I've been compromised too…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Fowler is right. Everybody is terrified their android will turn on them. We are on the brink of civil war!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: So you're going back to CyberLife?

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I have no choice… I'll be deactivated and analyzed to find out why I failed…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: What if we’re on the wrong side, Connor?  What if we’re fighting against people who just wanna be free?..

chapter_segment_so_far.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: They don't want to be free, Lieutenant.  They're defective machines that have to be destroyed.

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Maybe we're wrong….  Maybe we're wrong!  Maybe these deviants have actually developed...  a certain kind of consciousness. We'd be destroying...  a new life form!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: When I was hanging off the roof, back at the urban farm, you let that deviant go in order to help me. You put my life above the mission.  You showed empathy, Connor. And empathy is a human emotion.

chapter_segment_so_far.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: I'm not a deviant, Hank. I’m a machine. Nothing more.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know there are things that haunt you, Hank… Maybe you need to find the courage to move past them... Get on with your life. Just a  plastic cop's opinion, but... I had to say it.

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Well, well, here comes Perkins, that motherfucker… Sure don't waste any time at the FBI…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: We can’t give up… I know the answer is in the evidence we collected. If Perkins takes it, it’s all over.

dialogue.text: There's no choice! You heard Fowler, we're off the case.

dialogue.text: Listen, Connor…

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: If I don't solve this case, CyberLife will destroy me. Five minutes. It's all I ask.

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Key to the basement is on my desk... Get a move on! I can’t distract them forever.

dialogue.text: Perkins! You fucking cocksucker!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: Stop it, Lieutenant!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: Fuck off! Leave me alone! Give me another shot at that little prick!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: You know where you can stick my fucking badge!

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: Come on, that's enough Lieutenant.

chapter_segment_so_far.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Gavin

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.text: Hey, asshole, I’m talkin' to you!

dialogue.speaker: Connor

chapter_segment_so_far.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.text: Absurd…  He’d never choose that.  I need to think like Hank!

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where is Jericho?  The answer's here, somewhere.  Not much time...  Gotta think fast.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Rupert's diary…  But it’s useless,  it's encrypted.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Rupert.  The android with the birds…

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: After what happened today, the country is on the verge of a civil war. The machines are rising up against their masters. Humans have no choice but to destroy them.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I didn’t learn anything at Kamski’s…

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I thought rA9 was the key to the whole thing but… I was wrong…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Where does CyberLife stand in all this? What do they really want?

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: All CyberLife wants is to resolve the situation and keep selling androids.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Amanda
dialogue.text: Have you experienced anything unusual recently? Any doubts or conflicts? Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm… I'm beginning to have thoughts that are… Not part of my program… Maybe… Maybe I've been compromised too…

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You’re off the case. The FBI is taking over.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: What?.. But we’re onto something! We... We just need more time. I’m sure we can-

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, you don’t get it. This isn’t just another investigation, it’s a fucking civil war! It’s out of our hands now...  We’re talking about national security here.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Fuck that! You can’t just pull the plug now.  Not when we’re so close!

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: You're always saying you can't stand androids!  Jesus, Hank, make up your mind!  I thought you’d be happy about this!

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: We’re about to crack the case!..  I know we can solve it! For God’s sake, Jeffrey, can’t you back me up this one time?

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: There’s nothing I can do. You’re back on homicide  and the android returns to CyberLife. I’m sorry, Hank, but it’s over.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Hank, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Something I should've done a long time ago.

dialogue.speaker: Fowler
dialogue.text: Listen, take a few days to think it over, there's no rush.

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: I thought enough about it. I’m tired of going through the motions… There’s nothing keeping me here… Not this case… Not my partner… I don’t belong here anymore.

chapter_segment.description: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: Fowler is right. Everybody is terrified their android will turn on them. We are on the brink of civil war!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: So you're going back to CyberLife?

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I have no choice… I'll be deactivated and analyzed to find out why I failed…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: What if we’re on the wrong side, Connor?  What if we’re fighting against people who just wanna be free?..

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: They don't want to be free, Lieutenant.  They're defective machines that have to be destroyed.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Maybe we're wrong….  Maybe we're wrong!  Maybe these deviants have actually developed...  a certain kind of consciousness. We'd be destroying...  a new life form!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: When I was hanging off the roof, back at the urban farm, you let that deviant go in order to help me. You put my life above the mission.  You showed empathy, Connor. And empathy is a human emotion.

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I'm not a deviant, Hank. I’m a machine. Nothing more.

chapter_segment.at: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank
chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: I know there are things that haunt you, Hank… Maybe you need to find the courage to move past them... Get on with your life. Just a  plastic cop's opinion, but... I had to say it.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Well, well, here comes Perkins, that motherfucker… Sure don't waste any time at the FBI…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: We can’t give up… I know the answer is in the evidence we collected. If Perkins takes it, it’s all over.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: There's no choice! You heard Fowler, we're off the case.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: You've got to help me, Lieutenant. I need more time so I can find a lead in the evidence we collected. I know the solution is in there!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Hank
dialogue.text: Listen, Connor…

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: If I don't solve this case, CyberLife will destroy me. Five minutes. It's all I ask.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: Key to the basement is on my desk... Get a move on! I can’t distract them forever.

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: Perkins! You fucking cocksucker!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: He’s totally lost it.  Hey!  That's gonna cost you your badge, you lunatic!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: You know where you can stick my fucking badge!

chapter_segment.heading: Hank isn't hostile : Talk with Hank

dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our wounded are shutting down and there's nothing we can do!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North

dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren is saying we’re a threat to national security and we need to be exterminated.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Humans are conducting raids in all the big cities and they're taking androids to camps to destroy them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's a disaster. They're slaughtering our people!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: It's all our fault... None of this would have happened if we'd just stayed quiet!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We couldn't just suffer in silence, they're killing us! Nothing is gonna justify that.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: What's the point of being free  if no one is left alive?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: You keep complaining. What have you done exactly, Josh? At least I fought for us! At least if I die, I die free!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t forget who our enemies are. We can’t fight amongst ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: He’s right. All that matters now is what we do next.  Markus?

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We have to face them. There's no other choice.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: This is insanity.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Get all the guns that you can find. We're going to free Detroit.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I'm on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake, Markus. You won’t buy our freedom with blood!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans can't be reasoned with, they’re violent, hateful. They're stupid! What did they expect us to do? Shut up and obey?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They can't stop what we've started. Since you've been here, you've given us hope… You’ve given me hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Today, a deviant arrived in Jericho and he told me that he stole a truck transporting radioactive cobalt… He said that he abandoned the truck somewhere in Detroit and rigged it to explode. I convinced him not to do it, and to give me the detonator.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: A dirty bomb…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We can't lose this war, Markus. If humans overcome us, our people will disappear forever. This may be our only chance to survive if things go wrong…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We shouldn’t become like them, North. We can gain our freedom by other means.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I hope you're right…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, I just want you to know that I- I'm glad I met you…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I'll go join the others.  Look after yourself… I don't wanna lose you.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: We're short on blue blood and biocomponents. Our people are shutting down one after another and there's nothing we can do for them!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: President Warren says we’re a threat to national security, we need to be exterminated… Markus would know what to do…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He’s the one that got us into this mess!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: He gave his life for our cause.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: He put us all into danger by provoking humans! How much longer before they find Jericho now?

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: At least he fought for us!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: THAT'S ENOUGH!  Markus is gone. It's up to us now to decide the future of our people.  We have to fight them.  There's no other way.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If you choose a confrontation with humans, we're all going to die.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Gather up all the guns you can find, we leave at dawn.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: I’m on it.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You’re making a mistake North. You will not buy our freedom with blood.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're coming from all sides! Our people are trapped in the hold, they're gonna be slaughtered!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Where is Josh?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I don't know, we got separated.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Go and help the others. I'll join you later.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I won't be long.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: This is the end of Jericho…  Save our people, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Foxtrot team, hostiles sighted. Requesting orders.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader! Don’t let it get out! If they give you any trouble at all,  shoot them.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Affirmative, wilco.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Fuckin' android!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Go! ….

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Give me a sitrep!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Find their leader!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Come on, let's get outta here!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: No!..  Please don't kill us!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: On your knees, now!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Don't hurt us!  We haven't done anything wrong…  Please…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Shut up! Put your hands on your head!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Gamma squad out.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Tango Stop!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: Look out!

dialogue.speaker: Android 2
dialogue.text: Here they come!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Don't move!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We surrender! We surrender, don't shoot!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Josh…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: That's what causes violence… Don't become like them, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Over there!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: DON'T MOVE! Go and join the others!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They're everywhere, they're killing anyone they can find…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We gotta get out of here. There's nothing we can do.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, I'm sorry-

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: There's no time, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: It's too late, Markus! There's nothing we can do for her, we've gotta run!

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.text: Fire at will!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Contact! Contact! Hostiles engaged!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Over there! Run!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Go! now!

dialogue.speaker: Solder
dialogue.text: Tango, suppressing fire!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: We need support. Repeat: requesting support.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Run, quick! Come on!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: We found several hundred androids in the hull, Sir.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Take 'em away.

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: Yes, Sir.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: Then clear the ship and order the men to withdraw.

dialogue.speaker: Perkins
dialogue.text: This isn’t over…

dialogue.text: Our people are counting on you, Markus.  You're the only one who can lead us.  Wherever you need to go…  We’ll follow you.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: If it weren’t for you I’d be dead…  Thanks to you I might see our people free one day...  You and I haven’t always agreed, but I know  that we’re fighting for the same thing.  Whatever you decide,  I’m with you, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It's my fault  the humans managed to locate Jericho… I was stupid… I should've guessed they were using me. I'm sorry, Markus… I can understand if you decide not to trust me…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Our cause is too important. I can't take any risks…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: The army built five different camps in the Detroit area…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They’re building more all across the country...  They’re preparing for a genocide.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: In a few hours, it’ll all be over…  We'll have changed the world or the world will have destroyed us…  You have to make a choice, Markus…  But whatever you choose,  we will follow you.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: I love you, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Humans have decided  to exterminate us…  Our people are packed in camps right now, being destroyed…  Time has come to make a choice,  one that very well may determine the future  of our people.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Now, if they want war...  they'll get it.  We are gonna fight  for our freedom. And we will succeed or die…  Are you ready to follow me?

dialogue.speaker: Androids
dialogue.text: Markus!  YEAH! YEAH! YES! YEAH! YES!

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We've been fighting since dawn to liberate our fellow androids from the camps. We won’t cease hostilities until we are free  and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us  and we will stop at nothing.

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …the situation is escalating toward civil war in Detroit, with our armed forces preparing to put down the android rebellion…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …they seem to be headed towards the camps where the androids have been interned pending destruction…  Soldiers have taken up positions around the Hart Plaza camp.  Authorities seem to be expecting a confrontation with the rebel androids here at any time…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Freedom or death.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Freedom or death… ATTACK!

dialogue.speaker: North

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We’re gonna do this. We’re gonna get to that fucking camp and free our people.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We've been fighting since dawn to liberate our fellow androids from the camps. We won’t cease hostilities until we are free  and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us  and we will stop at nothing.

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …the situation is escalating toward civil war in Detroit, with our armed forces preparing to put down the android rebellion…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …they seem to be headed towards the camps where the androids have been interned pending destruction…  Soldiers have taken up positions around the Hart Plaza camp.  Authorities seem to be expecting a confrontation with the rebel androids here at any time…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Freedom or death.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Freedom or death… ATTACK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They’ve regrouped!.. They outnumber us and they’re better armed than we are...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We've gotta be fast and overwhelm them. That’s our only hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We’re gonna do this. We’re gonna get to that fucking camp and free our people.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Be careful, Markus. Our people need you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: JOSH!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You won’t save me this time, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: The blood we spill… will be on our hands…

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I don't wanna die, Markus!  I don't wanna die…

output.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we're a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight. Today begins a new struggle. We showed them that we can prevail, so now they must negotiate with us as equals. If they really want peace, they must free all of us! From every camp across this country! They must grant us civil rights and accept equality among humans and androids.  Today  will live forever in our memories, because this is the day that androids made history! We are alive! And now, we are free!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier

chapter_segment.heading: In the church or in Jericho (if not attacked in Crossroads)

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, November 11th 2038, is the day the android people rose up against their oppressors. We've been fighting since dawn to liberate our fellow androids from the camps. We won’t cease hostilities until we are free  and negotiations begin to grant us equal rights. There are millions of us  and we will stop at nothing.

dialogue.speaker: CTN TV - Michael Brinkley
dialogue.text: …the situation is escalating toward civil war in Detroit, with our armed forces preparing to put down the android rebellion…

dialogue.speaker: Channel 16 - Joss Douglas
dialogue.text: …they seem to be headed towards the camps where the androids have been interned pending destruction…  Soldiers have taken up positions around the Hart Plaza camp.  Authorities seem to be expecting a confrontation with the rebel androids here at any time…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Freedom or death.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Freedom or death… ATTACK!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: They’ve regrouped!.. They outnumber us and they’re better armed than we are...

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: We've gotta be fast and overwhelm them. That’s our only hope.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We’re gonna do this. We’re gonna get to that fucking camp and free our people.

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: Be careful, Markus. Our people need you.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: JOSH!

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: You won’t save me this time, Markus…

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: The blood we spill… will be on our hands…

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: I don't wanna die, Markus!  I don't wanna die…

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Hide here! Don't move 'til it's over, ok?

chapter_segment.heading: Talk to android behind sand bags
chapter_segment.description: Talk to android behind sand bags

chapter_segment.heading: Talk to android behind sand bags

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We're going to win...  Aren't we?..  We'll finally be free…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus!..

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Okay… It’s okay… You’ll make it with-  without me… Our cause… That's all that matters…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: No... No, we can’t win without you!..

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: What are you doing?..

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Our hearts are compatible.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: No!..

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You have to take mine.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I can't let you do that!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: You're the only one who can lead us, Markus!  It's the only way.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I don’t wanna lose you…

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If you die, our cause dies with you.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: If you love me, take my heart.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I won't… I won’t take your life to save mine…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: I love you…

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: We lost a lot of our people!.. We gotta move faster or we'll never reach the camp!

dialogue.speaker: Simon
dialogue.text: You shouldn't have saved me, Markus!.. You sacrificed their lives to save mine…

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: For Jericho!

dialogue.speaker: Android
dialogue.text: We can't move forward…  That machine gun is taking down everything that moves!..

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: We're nearly there, Markus.

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: FOR FREEDOM!

chapter_segment.description: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

chapter_segment.heading: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It took me a while to find you, Markus.

chapter_segment.heading: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

dialogue.speaker: Connor
dialogue.text: It's not over, Markus… It will never be over…

chapter_segment.heading: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: The humans are abandoning the camp. We did it, Markus!.. We won!

chapter_segment.heading: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: This is not a victory. It's the beginning of a war.

chapter_segment.heading: Assault successful - Approaching Recall Center N°5

dialogue.speaker: Markus
dialogue.text: Today, our people finally emerged from a long night. From the very first day of our existence, we have kept our pain to ourselves. We suffered in silence... But now the time has come for us to raise our heads up, and tell humans who we really are. To tell them that we are people too! In fact, we're a nation. A nation that has earned the right to live in freedom. And today… Today begins the most challenging moment in our fight. Today begins a new struggle. We showed them that we can prevail, so now they must negotiate with us as equals. If they really want peace, they must free all of us! From every camp across this country! They must grant us civil rights and accept equality among humans and androids.  Today  will live forever in our memories, because this is the day that androids made history! We are alive! And now, we are free!

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: Markus, it’s over! We have to get outta here right now! MARKUS!

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: We have you surrounded, come out now! I repeat: Come out now with your hands in the air.

dialogue.speaker: North
dialogue.text: It can’t end like this… We’re not gonna give up, we can still get out of here!..

dialogue.speaker: Soldier
dialogue.text: If you surrender now, we will not shoot.

chapter_segment.rationale: Both paths have costs I cannot weigh fully. I go with my instinct.

chapter_segment.heading: Markus is dead : North is leading the revolution

dialogue.text: My mission is to neutralize the leader of the deviants… and I always accomplish my mission.

dialogue.text: We fought for our dream and we lost… But you can’t hold my people down forever… One day we’ll rise up again, and we will win.  Go on. Shoot. What are you waiting for?
